top_comments.body:
Also getting this on windows. 
Update - Claude code in WSL (with older node) managed to find and fix the issue in the node 25 version after looking at the update notes! Can confirm it's now working fine after letting it directly edit cli.js, i.e., decent chance this is the bugfix that needs to be pushed. Here's the summary.

## Root Cause

Node.js 25.0.0 removed the deprecated `SlowBuffer` class. Claude Code's bundled dependencies reference `SlowBuffer` in:
1. `buffer-equal-constant-time` packag
